meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后，你把从 cmem.ai → Connect 拿到的 sync token、user id、SyncHub URL 交给 Claude，它会写进插件的 config.json，让 hooks 能捕获并注入记忆。token 不会被回显，也不会进命令行。
howto.when: 当你要求设置或配对 claude-mem、连接 cmem，或直接给出 cmem.ai Connect 里的 sync token 等值时，它会接管完成凭据配置。

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem，这是我的 sync token：cm_xxx
say.note: 它会把凭据写进插件 config.json

say.text: 把我的 cmem key 加到 Cowork 里
say.note: 在本会话内完成插件配对

say.text: 看一下 claude-mem 的配置状态
say.note: 运行 status 并报告打码后的输出

howto.what_en: After installing, give Claude the sync token, user id and SyncHub URL from cmem.ai → Connect; it writes them into the plugin's config.json so hooks can capture and inject memory. The token is never echoed back.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up or pair claude-mem, connect cmem, or provide your cmem.ai Connect values such as the sync token.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem with this sync token: cm_xxx
say_en.note: Writes the credentials into the plugin config.json

say_en.text: Add my cmem key to Cowork
say_en.note: Pairs the plugin for this session
Runs status and reports masked output
